description.en: Lebanon, officially the Lebanese Republic, is a country in the Levant region of West Asia. Situated at the crossroads of the Mediterranean Basin and the Arabian Peninsula, it is bordered by Syria to the north and east, Israel to the south, and the Mediterranean Sea to the west; Cyprus lies a short distance from the coastline.
description.zh-CN: 黎巴嫩共和国，通稱黎巴嫩，位于亚洲西南部、地中海东岸，习惯上歸屬於中东国家。东北部与叙利亚接壤，南部与以色列为邻，西濒地中海。
description.zh-TW: 黎巴嫩共和國，通稱黎巴嫩，位於亞洲西南部、地中海東岸，習慣上歸屬於中東國家。東北部與敘利亞接壤，南部與以色列爲鄰，西瀕地中海。
